name: customerapp
description: Customer app for 24X7 home appliance service — Next.js static export + Capacitor, Firebase backend

scripts.//dev: Frontend dev server talks to the emulators. Start `npm run emulators` in another terminal first, or NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_EMULATORS=false will point it at a real project.
scripts.build: npm -w @app/shared run build && npm -w frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @app/shared run typecheck && npm -w frontend run typecheck && npm -w functions run typecheck
scripts.emulators: npm -w functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-customerapp --config backend/firebase.json --import backend/.emulator-data --export-on-exit backend/.emulator-data
scripts.seed: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-customerapp --config backend/firebase.json "npm -w functions run seed"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-customerapp --config backend/firebase.json "npm -w functions run test:rules"
scripts.//seed: Seeds a throwaway emulator. To seed the emulator you are actually running, use `npm -w functions run seed` in a second terminal while `npm run emulators` is up.
